description: This PHP script initializes and populates a recruitment-related database with job titles, vacancies, candidates, and associated data, mainly used for seeding a database with sample data for recruitment management.

methods.name: truncateTables
methods.description: Deletes data from relevant recruitment tables to reset the database state.

methods.name: addJobTitles
methods.description: Inserts predefined job titles into the 'ohrm_job_title' table and updates the unique ID tracker.

methods.name: addJobVacancies
methods.description: Adds predefined job vacancy records with descriptions read from text files and updates the ID tracker.

methods.name: addCandidates
methods.description: Populates candidate data, their associations with vacancies, and history, based on a name list and generating synthetic data.

methods.name: display
methods.description: A utility function intended for logging or printing, but currently commented out.

methods.name: checkQueryResult
methods.description: Checks the success of a mysqli query and performs a rollback if an error occurs.

methods.name: getCandidateQPartial
methods.description: Generates partial SQL for inserting candidate personal data.

methods.name: getCvQPartial
methods.description: Generates partial SQL for inserting candidate CV file data.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyQPartial
methods.description: Generates partial SQL for inserting candidate-vacancy association.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryQPartial
methods.description: Generates partial SQL for inserting candidate history records.
